slides.0.title: White wine blind-tasting practice
slides.0.subtitle: Judge climate and winemaking first, then narrow down to the grape
slides.1.title: Four switches for white wine deduction
slides.1.highlights.0.title: Acidity and alcohol
slides.1.highlights.0.content: High acid with low to medium alcohol → cool climate; medium-minus acid with high alcohol → warm climate. The combination is the fastest climate clue
slides.1.highlights.1.title: Aromatic or not
slides.1.highlights.1.content: Intense floral, lychee → Gewurztraminer, Muscat; lime, petrol, flowers → Riesling; neutral → Chardonnay, Melon, Pinot Grigio and others, needing winemaking clues
slides.1.highlights.2.title: Winemaking traces
slides.1.highlights.2.content: Butter (MLF), toast and vanilla (oak), bread and yeast (lees) usually point to Chardonnay or lees-aged wines
slides.1.highlights.3.title: Sweetness
slides.1.highlights.3.content: Noticeable sugar with high acid and low alcohol → a cool region with arrested fermentation (e.g. Mosel Riesling Kabinett); high sugar and high alcohol → botrytis or dried grapes
slides.1.content: Write reasons as “observation → inference”: e.g. “low alcohol + high acid + residual sugar → arrested fermentation in a cool region”.
slides.2.componentProps.slide.title: 🧠 Knowledge check
Exercise 1: pale lemon; medium-plus nose of green apple, lime, white flowers and wet stone; medium sweetness, high acidity, low alcohol (about 8%), light body, medium-plus finish, no oak. Deduce variety and region and justify.
Low alcohol + residual sugar + high acid → arrested fermentation, cool region
Lime, white flowers, no oak → aromatic, reductive winemaking
Variety: Riesling
Region: Mosel, Germany (Kabinett style); wet stone can link to slate
Quality and ageing: sugar–acid balance, ageing potential

The combination of low alcohol, noticeable sugar and high acidity points to fermentation stopped in a cool region; lime, white flowers and no oak suggest an aromatic, reductively made wine, most consistent with Riesling. A light body, about 8% alcohol and this sugar–acid structure are typical of Mosel Kabinett; the wet-stone minerality can be linked to slate. Sugar and acid are well balanced, with ageing potential.

Exercise 2: medium lemon; medium-plus nose of yellow apple, lemon, butter, toast, vanilla and hazelnut; dry, high acidity, medium-plus body, medium-plus alcohol, long finish. Deduce variety, region and winemaking.
Butter → MLF; toast and vanilla → oak; hazelnut and texture → lees ageing
Neutral fruit carrying winemaking flavours → Chardonnay
High acid + moderate ripeness → cool to moderate climate
Region: e.g. Côte de Beaune in Burgundy (such as Meursault), contrasted with warm New World examples
Quality: good BLIC, can age

Butter comes from MLF, toast and vanilla from oak, hazelnut and roundness from lees ageing; these winemaking traces sit on neutral fruit, most consistent with Chardonnay. High acidity with moderately ripe yellow apple and lemon points to a cool to moderate climate, such as Meursault in the Côte de Beaune; warm New World versions usually have lower acidity and more tropical fruit. Intensity, length and complexity are all good, with ageing potential.

Exercise 3: pale lemon-green; pronounced nose of passion fruit, gooseberry, grapefruit, cut grass and tomato leaf; dry, high acidity, medium body, medium alcohol, no oak. Deduce variety and region and explain how to tell it from Sancerre.
Grass, tomato leaf → methoxypyrazines → Sauvignon Blanc
Pronounced tropical fruit (passion fruit) → Marlborough, New Zealand
High acid, no oak → cool, sunny, reductive winemaking
Versus Sancerre: Sancerre is more restrained, flinty and citrus, with little tropical fruit
Readiness: best drunk young

Grass and tomato leaf come from methoxypyrazines, the signature of Sauvignon Blanc; pronounced tropical passion fruit and gooseberry with high acidity and no oak fit Marlborough, New Zealand best: cool but very sunny, giving exuberant fruit. Sancerre is usually more restrained, flinty, citrus and mineral, with little tropical fruit. This style is best drunk young.
